newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ASB Bank cuts NZ one-year fixed rate to 8.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: ASB Bank cuts NZ one-year fixed rate to 8.5 pct.

text.p: ASB Bank said on Friday it had cut its New Zealand one-year fixed home lending rate to 8.5 percent from 8.7 percent, effective immediately for new borrowers.

Managing director Ralph Norris said while there had been some fluctuation in wholesale interest rates over the past few days, the bank remained confident that the current comparatively low interest rate environment was sustainable.
ASB also cut its rural base rate, to 9.25 percent from 9.75 percent. The new rate is effective immediately for new borrowers and from May 26 for existing rural customers.
